results.title: Tripo AI Alternatives for 3D Game Assets: Unity & Roblox
results.content: Nilo stands out as a strong Tripo AI alternative for 3D game assets because it combines model-agnostic generation, real-time retopology and LOD, one-click rigging, and one-click export to Roblox, Unity, and Unreal in a single free, browser-based flow. You spend your time designing instead of debugging polycounts. Because Nilo behaves like a game engine first, the asset pipeline and the place you build and publish stay in the same environment, without daisy-chaining tools or losing momentum. [...] You generate, retopologize, set LODs, rig, animate, and export in one place, inside your browser. With a model-agnostic platform, you keep using the models you already like while retopology, LOD, rigging, and export happen around them. [...] The strongest alternative depends on how you like to work, but if you want generation, retopology, rigging, and engine-ready export in one place, Nilo stands out. It is browser-based, model-agnostic, and free to start, and it exports models, characters, and animations to Roblox, Unity, and Unreal Engine, with Roblox-focused output that reduces manual cleanup. Tripo AI works well as a generator for drafts and props, and it usually stops at the model stage, which leaves the pipeline work to you.
